title: cosmos calvus
intro: Cosmos calvus, commonly known as "Mexican cosmos," is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cosmos calvus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. By harnessing the natural compounds found in this plant, researchers and practitioners have been exploring new avenues for the treatment and prevention of various diseases.
